title: Chapter 36
author: John A. Widtsoe
note: Published 1915. Modern systematic theology by Apostle Widtsoe. 30 chapters covering God, man, agency, ordinances, eternity.

footnotes.text: Cruden's Concordance to the Bible (or some other good concordance). A Complete Concordance to the Book of Mormon (George Reynolds). A Concordance to the Book of Doctrine and Covenants (John A. Widtsoe). No index has as yet been made for the Pearl of Great Price, but the book is small and may be read easily in its entirety.
The Compendium (Richards and Little) is the type after which most of the later compilations have been fashioned.
